def decode_raw_args(
    args: List[Union[str, bytes]],
    stdin_encoding: str
) -> List[str]:
    """
    Convert all bytes args to str
    by decoding them using stdin encoding.

    """
    return [
        arg.decode(stdin_encoding)
        if type(arg) is bytes else arg
        for arg in args
    ]
